target.title: fix(codex): resolve dynamic tool hard timeout from timeoutSeconds when timeoutMs is absent
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When a dynamic tool call passes `timeoutSeconds` (e.g. `{ timeoutSeconds: 120 }`) but omits `timeoutMs`, the hard-call timeout reader in `readDynamicToolCallTimeoutMs` only looks at `timeoutMs` and falls back to the default 90s guard. Tools that explicitly set a longer timeout in seconds (e.g. session send helpers) are capped by the default, causing premature timeouts and failed tool responses.

Fixes [#98864].

## Why This Change Was Made

`readDynamicToolCallTimeoutMs()` in `extensions/codex/src/app-server/dynamic-tool-execution.ts` read `timeoutMs` only and ignored `timeoutSeconds`. The fix applies the existing `readTimeoutSecondsAsMs` helper as a fallback when `timeoutMs` is absent or invalid — the same pattern already used for config-level image tool timeouts (`readTimeoutSecondsAsMs(config?.tools?.media?.image?.timeoutSeconds)`).

### Behavior rules (unchanged, timeoutSeconds is a new fallback)

| Priority | Input | Outcome |
|----------|-------|---------|
| 1 | `timeoutMs` is valid positive number | Use `timeoutMs` (existing behavior) |
| 2 | `timeoutMs` absent/invalid, `timeoutSeconds` valid | Use `timeoutSeconds * 1000` (**new**) |
| 3 | Both absent/invalid | Fall back to configured or default timeout (existing) |

## User Impact

- **Before**: Dynamic tool call `{ timeoutSeconds: 120 }` → reads `undefined` from `timeoutMs` → falls back to 90s default → tool times out prematurely
- **After**: Dynamic tool call `{ timeoutSeconds: 120 }` → reads `120000` from `timeoutSeconds` fallback → tool gets the full 120s

`timeoutMs` always wins when both are present; `timeoutSeconds` is a pure fallback. No existing callers are affected.

## Evidence

### Unit Tests (16/16 passed)

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/codex/src/app-server/dynamic-tool-execution.test.ts
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  16 passed (16)
```

3 new tests added:
- `resolves timeoutSeconds when timeoutMs is absent on a dynamic tool call` — `{ timeoutSeconds: 120 }` → `120000`
- `prefers timeoutMs over timeoutSeconds when both are present` — `{ timeoutMs: 30000, timeoutSeconds: 120 }` → `30000`
- `ignores invalid timeoutSeconds values the same way invalid timeoutMs is ignored` — `{ timeoutSeconds: "bad" }` → default

### Real Machine Runtime Verification

**Environment**: Linux x64, Node v24.18.0

```
=== 修改前 (314c53b814) ===
Case 1 - timeoutSeconds=120, 无 timeoutMs → 90000  ❌ 忽略 timeoutSeconds
Case 5 - timeoutMs="bad" + timeoutSeconds=60   → 90000  ❌ 忽略 timeoutSeconds

=== 修改后 (c5f8f79b82) ===
Case 1 - timeoutSeconds=120, 无 timeoutMs → 120000 ✅ timeoutSeconds 生效
Case 2 - timeoutMs=30000 + timeoutSeconds=120 → 30000  ✅ timeoutMs 优先
Case 3 - 无 timeoutMs 无 timeoutSeconds → 90000       ✅ 默认值不变
Case 4 - timeoutSeconds="bad" → 90000                ✅ 无效值忽略
Case 5 - timeoutMs="bad" + timeoutSeconds=60 → 60000  ✅ timeoutSeconds 回退
```

### Verification Summary

| Scenario | Expected | Actual |
|----------|---------|--------|
| `timeoutSeconds=120`, no `timeoutMs` | 120000 | ✅ |
| `timeoutMs=30000` + `timeoutSeconds=120` | timeoutMs wins (30000) | ✅ |
| Neither field | Default 90000 | ✅ |
| Invalid `timeoutSeconds="bad"` | Default 90000 | ✅ |
| Invalid `timeoutMs="bad"` + valid `timeoutSeconds=60` | 60000 | ✅ |

## Changes

- `extensions/codex/src/app-server/dynamic-tool-execution.ts`: `readDynamicToolCallTimeoutMs` returns `readPositiveFiniteTimeoutMs(value.timeoutMs) ?? readTimeoutSecondsAsMs(value.timeoutSeconds)` — 1 line changed
- `extensions/codex/src/app-server/dynamic-tool-execution.test.ts`: +3 test cases for timeoutSeconds fallback, timeoutMs priority, and invalid value handling — 45 lines added
